notes: creation is shared by accept and buy-now, which differ only in where the agreed terms come from. description: Money math (all integer santim)
notes: Integer santim only, no float anywhere in the arithmetic: percentages are exact fractions (2/100, 15/100) rounded once by round_half_up, which rounds a half up (250.5 -> 251) where Python round() would round half to even (250). Fee is clamped to 500..50000 after rounding, so the 25000 subtotal that is exactly 2% of the floor is the figure where the two rules meet. fee_payer is a setting (BUYER|SELLER|SPLIT_50, default BUYER) and moves only the split: platform_fee, vat and fee_vat are identical in all three branches. SPLIT_50 rounds the buyer half up and gives the seller the remainder so the halves sum to fee_vat exactly. Wired into both order-creating routes: totals are computed once at creation, stored, and returned as stored, and pickup carries no delivery charge

description: Staff authentication: password (min 12 chars) or passkey **plus TOTP MFA at ever
blocking_issue: Password minimum is 12 characters (scrypt, stdlib, parameters stored with the hash) and TOTP (RFC 6238, SHA-1, 6 digits, +/-1 step) is required on every login. TOTP secrets are encrypted at rest with Fernet. Staff sessions are capped at admin_jwt_ttl_seconds (8h); require_staff checks staff_sessions.expires_at against now() rather than trusting the JWT exp. A role change revokes the target's sessions (force re-auth). There is no passkey: it is an alternative the spec allows, not one this pilot implements, so password+TOTP is the whole of the factor story here. The first ADMIN is seeded by the seed_staff CLI (no public admin sign-up). Recorded in ADR 0016.
